questions.question: A letter to early Christians told them to make sure of one thing when someone wrongs them. What was it?

answers.text: That no one repays evil for evil
That the leaders settle it quickly

questions.question: A letter to early Christians gave two short commands about joy and prayer. Which two were they?

answers.text: Always rejoice and never stop praying
Rejoice on good days and pray every morning
Rejoice in private and pray in public
